app.title: Honeycomb ecosystem
app.heading: Life in the honeycomb
controls.stepHelp: Advance exactly one tick (1/60 simulation second)
settings.title: Settings
settings.help: All rates are per simulation second; 60 ticks = 1 s. Changes take effect when applied, starting a new run.
settings.saveHelp: Saving keeps the draft for future visits to this browser address. Defaults resets the form; apply or save afterwards.
settings.fileHelp: JSON files transfer settings only. Export downloads the valid form draft. Import replaces only the form; apply or save in the browser afterwards. The file stays on this device.
settings.pending: Changes have not been applied yet.
settings.savedDraft: Draft is saved in the browser.
settings.unsavedDraft: Draft has not been saved in the browser yet.
settings.invalidDraft: Draft is invalid and cannot be applied or saved yet.
settings.defaultsLoaded: Defaults loaded into the form. Apply to start; save in the browser for future visits.
settings.exported: JSON download started. The form draft was exported.
settings.imported: JSON settings loaded into the form. Apply to start; save in the browser for future visits.
storage.unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Defaults are active; settings can still be applied.
storage.invalid: Saved settings are invalid or incompatible. Defaults are active.
errors.storage: Settings could not be saved in the browser. They can still be applied.
errors.fileRead: The JSON file could not be read. Please select it again.
errors.json: The file does not contain valid JSON.
errors.record: A settings object with a version and configuration is required.
errors.version: This settings version is not supported.
errors.type: {{field}} is missing or has the wrong data type.
errors.population: The initial population exceeds the number of available cells.
errors.growth: Grass growth times efficiency must be less than herbivore energy drain per simulation second.
errors.canvas: This browser does not support Canvas 2D.
errors.unknown: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.

history.title: History
history.empty: Please select at least one series.
history.canvas: History over time; explore values with the mouse or arrow keys
history.help: Simulation seconds per chart width. Shorter span = faster movement. Count on the left, energy on the right.
history.sweepHelp: The cursor overwrites older history. To its right, the previous sweep remains visible more faintly; times refer to the respective section.
